about.title: About us
about.lead: We rent holiday cabins at Lake Sommen — with one simple idea: cabin and equipment in a single booking, so you can start your holiday right away.

sections.heading: Our idea
sections.body: Many holiday homes leave you wondering how to get to the boat, the bike or the sauna. With us, the right equipment comes with the cabin — no rentals on site, no extra costs. One price, one booking.

sections.heading: Lake Sommen
sections.body: Sommen lies in southern Sweden between Tranås and Boxholm — a clear, branching lake with over 350 islands. Ideal for swimming, fishing, paddling and long walks through quiet forests.

sections.heading: Personally looked after
sections.body: We know each of our cabins ourselves. Before your arrival you receive all the details on address, directions and key handover — and if you have questions, we're personally there for you.

contact.title: Contact & FAQ

faq.q: How do check-in and check-out work?
faq.a: Check-in is from 3:00pm, check-out by 11:00am. Other times can often be arranged by agreement.

faq.q: How does the key handover work?
faq.a: A few days before arrival you receive an email with the address, directions and key handover. Depending on the cabin, the key is in a lockbox or handed over in person.
The cabin plus the equipment listed for that cabin — for example a boat, kayak or sauna. Bed linen and towels are included.
Yes, the final cleaning is included in the price. We only ask that you leave the cabin swept and take care of dishes and rubbish.
In our dog-friendly cabins, pets are welcome at no extra cost. You'll find an overview on the "With dog" page.
Free cancellation is possible up to 30 days before arrival. After that we charge part of the amount. Please contact us as early as possible.
You pay securely by card, Klarna or SEPA direct debit via Stripe.

legal.cookieText: This website only uses technically necessary local storage (e.g. for your language choice). No tracking and no sharing with third parties.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: Protecting your personal data is important to us. This policy informs you, in line with the GDPR, about how we process your data.

sections.heading: Controller
sections.body: Sommen Cabins, 573 96 Tranås, Sweden, email: hallo@sommen-huetten.example. (Please replace with your real details.)

sections.heading: What data we process
sections.body: For a booking we process your name, email address and booking/payment data as needed to fulfil the contract. For a contact request we process the data you provide to answer your enquiry.

sections.heading: Payment processing
sections.body: Payment is handled by Stripe. The data required for payment is transmitted to Stripe. Stripe's privacy terms apply.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use only technically necessary local storage (e.g. for your language choice). No tracking or marketing cookies are set.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability. Please contact the address above to exercise these.
